feedback.author: DaizeDong
feedback.body:
Seems not necessary for a change here?
I found that the initialization method for router bias is the same in [vllm](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/model_executor/models/deepseek_v2.py#L120) and [HF](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/blob/main/modeling_deepseek.py#L412) for DS V3, using `nn.Parameter` that defaults as `FP32`. And there is no type conversion before calculation in the [original HF implementation](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/blob/main/modeling_deepseek.py#L440).
